items.rationale: The stock values from 10 up to (not including) 20 are 14, 10, 19 and 10, which makes 4 lines.
Nairobi rows have 8, 14, 22 and 10 pairs. Of these, 14, 22 and 10 are at least 10, so the count is 3.
<=20 includes 20, and >=20 also includes 20, so the line falls in both bands and the totals double count it. Using < for the upper limit ("<20") fixes the overlap.
COUNTIFS counts rows where all conditions are true (AND). A single cell cannot hold two different regions, so nothing matches. To count two regions you would add two separate COUNTIF results.
